maya_csm: FYI — Pelican Logistics opened a private model request this morning. wants a 13B quantized variant behind VPC + HSM, retention policy, and ops SLA.
chris_se: got it. do we have guidance on quantized 13b perf on Dedicated? latency target?
maya_csm: they asked for p95 < 150ms for short-chat (<=256 tokens) and steady throughput ~20 req/s. also strict audit logs and key custody via customer-managed HSM.
nadia_safety: flagging safety: their data is shipment manifests and customer PII (addresses, phone numbers). need PII redaction + regression evals against our privacy promptset. also request for a pre-deploy safety signoff.
sagar_infra: infra notes: VPC + HSM + private control plane is doable. need to validate NLB limits for 20 rps and confirm autoscaling buffer. also will need model bundle (onnx/ggml) and quant profile to match runtime kernels.
maya_csm: customer prefers on-prem HSM, timeline ~3 weeks. they want a canary rollout then full cutover. can we give a realistic timeline?
chris_se: high level plan: 1) collect model artifact + quant profile (3 days), 2) safety/evals + privacy redaction tests (5 days), 3) infra setup (VPC/HSM) + canary (4 days), 4) monitoring + runbook + handover (3 days). total ~15 working days.
nadia_safety: for evaluations I'll need: sample manifests (sanitized), a prompt set for PII extraction, and failure thresholds (e.g., >99% redaction for addresses). can the CSM get those from the customer?
maya_csm: i'll ask Pelican for sanitized samples and confirm retention window (they mentioned 90 days but i want to lock it).
sagar_infra: quick config snippet i'll use for the canary nodepool:```yaml
nodePool:
  gpuType: a10g
  minReplicas: 2
  maxReplicas: 6
  canaryCapacity: 0.1 # 10% traffic
  autoscaleThresholdQPS: 25
```
chris_se: also propose fallback routing policy to a smaller hosted reranker if latency spikes: `route: latency_first -> fallback: hosted-small-emb`
maya_csm: customer also asked about encryption-at-rest + audit log retention of 1 year. legal already ok with 90-day data retention for inputs, but logs need 1yr — can we support that?
sagar_infra: logs can be forwarded to their SIEM; retention configurable. HSM for keys is fine but will need a service account with delegated access. will need onboarding doc for their security team.
nadia_safety: schedule a short enablement session for their ML ops team during canary. cover how to interpret redaction failure alerts and rollback steps.
maya_csm: I'll propose timeline and request list to Pelican in the hour. action items: @chris_se prepare eval harness + baseline run, @sagar_infra draft infra canary plan + runbook, @nadia_safety prepare privacy promptset checks. deploy-bot: created ticket CS-4721 for Pelican private onboarding.
deploy-bot: Ticket CS-4721 created by maya_csm · assignees: chris_se, sagar_infra, nadia_safety · due: 2026-04-15
chris_se: acked, will start the baseline perf/eval tomorrow.
maya_csm: thanks all — i'll update thread after Pelican reply. :thumbsup:
